svg.title: Five lines, five silent ways to be wrong
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Five lines, five silent ways to be wrong” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. The PyTorch training step drawn as five numbered stations - zero_grad, forward, loss, backward and step - with a big return arrow closing the loop and an amber annotation on each naming its characteristic silent failure, beside a separate evaluation block where model.eval and inference_mode are ticked and their wrong versions struck out, a crossed-out resume that loads the state dict without the optimizer, and bars comparing 41.2 against 27.8 milliseconds per step.
svg.text: Five lines, five silent ways to be wrong
draw it from memory, then compare
